items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: one of the trumpet players was Walter Duncans, which we all went to school together. We grew up together.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, what I'm thinking is that Nat Towles came up and fronted the band I'm talking about, Lawson's band, in Dallas. And that became Nat Towles' band. Or maybe it became the second band he had or something.

Well, I don't know about the second -- the second band? See, now, when I met the guys in the band, even Henry Coker was playing trombone in the band, and one of the trumpet players was Walter Duncans, which we all went to school together. We grew up together. And the bass player
was from Dallas, and his mother was a music teacher. Buddy Tate was in the band. Did I tell you?
